answer: Each identity docks at a harbor ledger with a 60-credit sybil-tax bond. Each epoch a prism audit splits each identity's work into a spectrum; identical spectra expose a rented cluster. Identities funded from one ridge pay an escalating tax: first 60, k-th 60+12(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 6,054,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A bought harbor identity fails the prism check when its spectrum mismatches its history; the bond burns. An honest agent pays 60 once.
